_doc: Single source of truth for WHICH Zernio owner(s)/platform(s) a video lane
publishes to. Read by scripts/queue-finished-videos.py at ingestion time.
Edit THIS FILE to change routing -- never sprinkle a new owner/platform
conditional into scripts/queue-finished-videos.py or api/cron-post-videos.js.
SHAPE: each lane has a `targets` array. Every target is one
{owner, platforms, role} triple -- one target = one video_library row
(video_library.target_owner can only hold ONE owner per row, so a lane
that should reach two owners from the same physical file gets TWO rows,
both pointing at the same uploaded asset). `role` is 'primary' (the main
reach vehicle for this lane) or 'also' (a secondary echo); it's
descriptive only -- queue-finished-videos.py keys lookups off `owner`,
never off array position or role.
WHY THIS EXISTS (Atlas, 2026-09-30 -- ISP-cutover routing task):
45 days of live post_analytics (1,311 posts: FB 599 / LinkedIn 521 / IG 191)
averaged 1 / 0 / 2 views with zero shares on any platform -- everything
published to the Dossie brand accounts, which have single-digit-to-low-
double-digit followers. Heath's OWN personal accounts
(@heathshepardrealtor IG: 982 followers, HeathShepardRealtor FB: 416
followers, both already connected in zernio_accounts under
owner='heath-realtor') sit idle. Per memory
social-growth-research-2026-09-26.md, a personal-account post gets ~3x
the engagement of the identical post from a brand account, and YouTube
Shorts median views for a sub-5k-follower channel (Socialinsider, 69M
videos) is 15,160 vs 625 for Instagram Reels -- so both of Heath's
connected YouTube channels (dossie's @meetdossie AND heath-realtor's
'Shepard Real Estate Solutions') matter, not just IG/FB.
'founder' content (Heath physically on camera, vertical, filmed selfie-
style -- see docs/WEEKLY-RECORDING-KIT.md + memory
multi-take-splice-workflow.md) is the ONLY content this reroutes.
Screen-recording/skit/product-demo content (no face, no personal voice)
stays brand-only -- the 3x-engagement research is specifically about
content FROM A PERSON, not about Dossie's product demos wearing a
different account.
LinkedIn is deliberately EXCLUDED from every video lane below. Per
docs/CONTENT-FORMAT-LIBRARY.md §6 item 2 / CLAUDE.md §14, LinkedIn video
views fell 36% YoY and carousels/documents median 21.8% engagement vs
7.4% for video on that platform. LinkedIn's content path is the
document/carousel post (api/cron-publish-approved.js, social_posts
table) -- a completely separate pipeline from this file. A video lane
that includes 'linkedin' here would just add a worse-performing surface
the carousel pipeline already covers better.
